scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Reimbursement Of Free On Board (FOB) Expenses
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: New or existing manufacturing/service units undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20.05.2022 and 19.05.2027
Enterprise must apply within six months from 31st March of the previous financial year
benefits_summary: 20% reimbursement of FOB value up to ₹20,00,000 per beneficiary per year for three years.
